description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/spaces/{id}/roles/reorder`: every role of the space except
`@everyone`, bottom to top (index 0 → position 1).

role_ids.description: Distinct role ids, bottom to top.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).
